description: This file defines an abstract base configuration class for interactions with a Google-based Interactions API within a larger language model framework. It includes method signatures for transforming requests and responses, URL generation, error handling, and streaming support, intended to be implemented by provider-specific subclasses.

classes.name: BaseInteractionsAPIConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class providing method signatures and common logic for configuring and transforming requests/responses for Google Interactions API implementations, supporting model and agent interactions, streaming, and error handling.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Abstract property to return the LLM provider identifier.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Class method returning a dictionary of the class's non-private, non-callable attributes.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to return a list of supported parameters for a given model.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Abstract method to validate and prepare environment settings such as headers.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: Optional[str], agent: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to construct the complete URL for an interaction request based on base URL, model, agent, and params.

methods.name: Dict transform_request( self, model: Optional[str], agent: Optional[str], input: Optional[InteractionInput], optional_params: InteractionsAPIOptionalRequestParams, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to transform input and parameters into a request body for the provider.

methods.name: InteractionsAPIResponse transform_response( self, model: Optional[str], raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a raw httpx.Response into the API's response format.

methods.name: InteractionsAPIStreamingResponse transform_streaming_response( self, model: Optional[str], parsed_chunk: dict, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a parsed streaming chunk into a streaming response object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_interaction_request( self, interaction_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to construct URL and params for get interaction request.

methods.name: InteractionsAPIResponse transform_get_interaction_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process the response from a get interaction request.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_interaction_request( self, interaction_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to construct URL and body for delete interaction request.

methods.name: DeleteInteractionResult transform_delete_interaction_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, interaction_id: str, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process the response from a delete interaction request.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_cancel_interaction_request( self, interaction_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to construct URL and body for cancel interaction request.

methods.name: CancelInteractionResult transform_cancel_interaction_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process the response from a cancel interaction request.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Method to generate an exception instance based on error details. Raises a BaseLLMException.

methods.name: bool should_fake_stream( self, model: Optional[str], stream: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Method to determine if streaming should be faked; can be overridden by subclasses. Defaults to False.
